title: This Shark Swallowed the Infinity Gauntlet
description: Jeff the Land Shark just wanted to cool off during a heat wave. It ends with an X-ray nobody at the clinic was ready for.
hook_note: Opens on a tiny sweating shark melting on the kitchen floor - instantly adorable and instantly a problem.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Jeff the Land Shark, and today he is melting.

segments.text: This is Jeff the Land Shark, and today he is melting.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: A heat wave is cooking him alive, and he needs somewhere cold, fast.

segments.text: A heat wave is cooking him alive, and he needs somewhere cold, fast.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Which is when he spots the coldest place in the house.

segments.text: Which is when he spots the coldest place in the house.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: His eyes turn to snowflakes, and Jeff moves in.

segments.text: His eyes turn to snowflakes, and Jeff moves in.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Enter Kate Bishop, his long-suffering owner, who walks into a crime scene,

segments.text: Enter Kate Bishop, his long-suffering owner, who walks into a crime scene,

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: and finds one shark fast asleep inside her fridge.

segments.text: and finds one shark fast asleep inside her fridge.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Hawkeye lays down the law: the fridge is off-limits.

segments.text: Hawkeye lays down the law: the fridge is off-limits.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Out back, Jeff finds a pool, and a hose to fill it with.

segments.text: Out back, Jeff finds a pool, and a hose to fill it with.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Only for the little land shark to chomp straight through it.

segments.text: Only for the little land shark to chomp straight through it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So Jeff makes a phone call, to exactly the right friend.

segments.text: So Jeff makes a phone call, to exactly the right friend.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Enter Iceman, the X-Man you call when your dog is a shark, who buries the yard in snow.

segments.text: Enter Iceman, the X-Man you call when your dog is a shark, who buries the yard in snow.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And Jeff gets the best day of his life, snow angels included.

segments.text: And Jeff gets the best day of his life, snow angels included.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: That night, however, Jeff's stomach starts making sounds a stomach should not make,

segments.text: That night, however, Jeff's stomach starts making sounds a stomach should not make,

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: and Kate finds him collapsed, bundles him up, and bolts for the clinic.

segments.text: and Kate finds him collapsed, bundles him up, and bolts for the clinic.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: One very confused doctor finds nothing, so they take an X-ray.

segments.text: One very confused doctor finds nothing, so they take an X-ray.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Inside is a donut, a burger, a license plate, and, holy hell, the Infinity Gauntlet.

segments.text: Inside is a donut, a burger, a license plate, and, holy hell, the Infinity Gauntlet.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Kate facepalms and yells one word: 'JEFFREY!'

segments.text: Kate facepalms and yells one word: 'JEFFREY! '

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: She still feels bad for him, so she builds Jeff his own house.

segments.text: She still feels bad for him, so she builds Jeff his own house.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: He moves in, parks on the welcome mat, and invites Kate over.

segments.text: He moves in, parks on the welcome mat, and invites Kate over.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And the second she peeks inside, Jeff punts her straight through the door,

segments.text: And the second she peeks inside, Jeff punts her straight through the door,

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: leaving her stuck in the doghouse, while Jeff enjoys a tropical drink.

segments.text: leaving her stuck in the doghouse, while Jeff enjoys a tropical drink.

cliffhanger_note: Kate is stuck in the doghouse and Jeff is not letting her out.
